description: Reads one WhatsApp number’s order settings: the delivery fee, the delivery zones and their fees, how long delivery takes (anywhere and per zone), the payment methods, AI order drafts, confirmation before shipping, the reminder hours, the deposit rule, the delivery messages, the Google Sheets sync, and the ready-made order templates with their status on the number. A number with no saved settings shows the defaults. Read-only.

id.description: The WhatsApp number, by its conn_ id.

name: get_order_settings
title: See a number’s order settings
